integrity: Analytical argument with an independently runnable diagnostic script; computational tests are finite and do not independently establish the asymptotic assertions.
scientific_limitations: Single one-dimensional Brownian particle, exponential Poisson reset clock, target drawn once and held fixed; no universality claim for alternative clocks, spatial priors, or redrawn targets.
The joint convergence is a long-time weak limit at fixed positive parameters. No claim of uniform convergence as the parameters vary.
Scientific priority is qualified against possible broad unindexed mixed-renewal and random-environment limit theorems.
title: Pareto search-time tails and a Gamma-selected hidden target under Poisson resetting
